capabilities: render Pokemon Showdown team exports as visual previews
display teams inside showdown code blocks
extras: The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README is minimal and shows only one usage example.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render or preview Pokemon Showdown team exports, which appear as plain code blocks.

relations.evidence: displays Pokémon built using Pokémon Showdown's team builder in Obsidian

summary: Renderer that displays Pokemon teams written in Pokemon Showdown team-builder format inside showdown code blocks.
